diagnostic_analysis.reported_type_mismatch: The formal inputBuffer type is int32_t*, but selected PCM storage is int16_t. The pinned public API documentation and wrapper comment explicitly establish the format-dependent byte layout.
diagnostic_analysis.inference: Scaling the selected 16-bit path by two-byte samples matches the documented input contract. Replacing it with int32_t scaling would change interleaved channel selection and could overrun a correctly sized 16-bit buffer. This supports intentional reinterpretation; it is not an approved false-positive disposition.
diagnostic_analysis.valid_read_bound: For N supplied samples in whole channel groups, C channels, and map m in [0,C-1], read indices are i*C+m with 0<=i<N/C. Last read N-C+m<=N-1. Public parameter validation rejects channel-map entries outside that range.
diagnostic_analysis.separate_pointer_formation_concern: Each loop iteration also performs src += C, including after its last read. For m>0 this forms base+(N+m), beyond the one-past base+N pointer. There is no subsequent dereference in that iteration, but this prevents a blanket pointer-arithmetic safety conclusion. ASan/UBSan passing memory-access tests alone does not prove the pointer formation conforms.
diagnostic_analysis.other_limits: The historical int32_t* intermediate also deserves alignment review against the documented int16_t alignment contract. Current buffers generally satisfy stronger allocation alignment; tests should include an int16-aligned offset. Out-of-contract short allocations cannot be detected from a bare pointer/sample count; do not label them supported. Nonwhole channel groups are outside the documented caller contract.

existing_behavior_evidence.observed: Six targets / 36 Unity cases pass; real mono/stereo/eight-channel configuration and PCM/AAC media recovery controls exist. test_faac_encoder source covers mono encode/flush and HE configuration, but that target was not selected in this T7.16 run.
existing_behavior_evidence.reuse_scope: Context for actual static linkage and available valid media paths only. These tests do not isolate CODEQL-330, distinct multichannel sample selection, map bounds or final pointer formation. No exact-finding regression claimed.

application_allocation_review.finding: Both steady-state and final partial PCM blocks use AVFrame AV_SAMPLE_FMT_S16 buffers allocated with av_frame_get_buffer(f,0), then pass f->data[0] and whole channel-group counts. Installed FFmpeg header documents CPU-selected alignment for zero alignment request.
application_allocation_review.limit: This helps explain observed aligned application buffers; no universal proof of sufficient excess array extent for final-stride formation, no waiver of the public FAAC int16/packed24 alignment contract, no upstream safety inference from passing host tests.

tracked_patch_proposal.code_change: Use const void* end-to-end through private faacEncEncode and appendInputFifo; public facade passes in directly. For INPUT_16BIT, INPUT_32BIT and INPUT_FLOAT use const format-correct base pointers and indexed reads base[i*numChannels+map] instead of a terminal strided increment. Preserve existing numeric scaling/float screening and packed24 semantics. No public ABI or codec policy change.
tracked_patch_proposal.static_reason: For each actual read, 0 <= i*C+m <= N-1; no pointer is formed for i==N/C. Format-specific casts are performed only after selecting the documented format. The unused terminal pointer and unnecessary int32 roundtrip disappear by construction; tests alone cannot establish that property.
tracked_patch_proposal.materialization: At configure, verify exact pinned commit and input hashes. Copy libfaac and public include directories into a newly owned build-local staging tree without symlinks or Git metadata; apply the committed unified diff with Git to that copy only; verify exact postimage hashes before publishing the build-local tree. Compile every FAAC translation unit and quoted private header from the consistent copy. Preserve licenses. Fail closed on drift, malformed/unexpected patch paths, failed application, stale/tampered outputs or mixed original/copied headers. No network access or upstream checkout mutation during configure.

tracked_patch_proposal.manifest: Tracked manifest pins upstream repository/commit, every copied source input hash, patch hash and expected changed output hashes. Generated build manifest maps canonical upstream-relative paths to actual compiled relative paths with input/output hashes, compiler/profile and patch identity; archive alongside compile_commands and scanner reports. No #line disguise or original-path substitution.
tracked_patch_proposal.scanner_obligation: CodeQL source archive must contain/hash-match actual patched frame.c/faac.c/private header and manifest mapping. Existing clang/cppcheck src-only selection must retain all previous src coverage and explicitly include compiled patched FAAC translation units; record actual execution, not candidate lists. Missing/unscanned generated files are coverage failures, not clean findings. Keep raw generated SARIF paths and reconcile original CODEQL-330 fingerprint via provenance only during T33.
tracked_patch_proposal.validation_limits: Existing T7.24.1 tests passed unchanged code; report them as behavior preservation, not a manufactured RED/GREEN. Add meaningful RED controls for source/patch/hash/path drift and missing/mismatched compiled scanner provenance. Static code review provides the terminal-index proof. Any new real regression remains RED.
